item.title: Mario Kart World is a great vibes game
item.description:
I think a lot of the youtube influencer mass opinion machine is missing the point of Mario Kart World.
It's a game for kids. It's always been a game for kids. and it works perfectly as a "boot it up and drive around doing whatever" game for a few minutes before putting on a race with your friends. It's especially nice that the world is a loading screen between online matches so the dicking around never stops.
There's a sense of serenity with seamlessly transit
